Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Mason of the Mounted
programme.desc: Canadian Mountie Mason is sent south of the border to look for a horse thief with only a watch chain for evidence. He befriends young Andy and when Calhoun hits Andy, Mason and Calhoun fight. In the scuffle Calhoun's watch with the missing chain is dislodged. Mason then sets out to bring in Calhoun and his gang.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Feud of the Trail
programme.desc: Feud of the Trail places the dashing Tom Tylerr, a B-Western star (and the original Captain Marvel) in dual roles; as a man seeking justice against a band of outlaws, and the bands vicious gang leader. Capably directed by helmer Robert F. Hill (Flash Gordon, Tarzan the Fearless), and shot at the iconic Lazy A Ranch outside of Los Angeles, the film follows Tom Wade, an honorable man with a face thats nearly identical to nefarious gang leader Jack Granger. Using this to his advantage, Wade exploits his similar looks to impersonate the gangster and infiltrate his band of ruffians.

programme.title: Billy The Kid Returns
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: Oscar winner Michael Curtiz (Casablanca, Mildred Pierce) directed this exciting drama about Army officer Jeb Stuart and the days leading up to the Civil War. Errol Flynn (The Adventures of Robin Hood) stars as Stuart, with Olivia de Havilland as his romantic interest (the seventh of nine times they were paired together by Warner Bros.) The cast includes Ronald Reagan as General George Custer, and Raymond Massey as John Brown, with such familiar faces as Alan Hale and Van Hefflin in supporting roles. Filmed partly in Santa Fe!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: Fast Bullets
programme.desc: Tom Tyler stars in this vintage western from the short-lived Reliable Pictures Company, a group known for low budgets and lots of action. In this feature, Tom reforms a gang member in order to infiltrate a ring of thieves. Rex Lease, Margaret Nearing, and Al Bridge also star.

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Phantom Ranger
programme.desc: Cowboy hero Tim McCoy stars as Tim Hayes, a two-fisted G-Man working for the FBI on a counterfeit money case. The incredibly daring Hayes infiltrates a gang that has kidnapped a Treasury Department engraver. Under the direction of Poverty Row icon Sam Newfield, McCoy turns in another of his legendary slam-bang performances, making Phantom Ranger a perennial favorite of B-Western fans.

programme.title: In Old Cheyenne
programme.desc: Roy Rogers plays a newspaper reporter sent to Cheyenne to investigate a reputed troublemaker. While on the scene, he discovers who the real bad guys are, and sets out to right some wrongs. Also starring Roy's usual sidekick George 'Gabby' Hayes, plus Joan Woodbury, and George Rosener. This Republic Pictures western was helmed by director Joseph Kane (The Undersea Kingdom, Dakota) and features two musical numbers: 'Bonita' and 'Linda Flor'.

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of...

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business!

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as...

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. He's assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and learn about the emir's activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Red Ryder: Roll, Thunder, Roll!
programme.desc: Red Ryder finds two silver conchas, the trademark of bandit El Conejo, at a raided ranch. He reports the raid to Marshal Bill Faugh but tells him that he suspects that El Conejo, a Robin Hood type character, is being framed.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Man from Music Mountain
programme.desc: Gene Autry stops singing long enough to take on some nasty land developers in this oldtime western from Republic Pictures. Of course, it wouldnt be a Gene Autry movie if there werent at least a few songs, and this one comes packed with such numbers as Im Beginning to Care, Love, Burning Love, and the title song. Genes longtime sidekick Smiley Burnette gets to sing a few, too, including She Works Third Tub at the Laundry.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies...

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Man from Utah
programme.desc: WHIRLING ROPES AND SNARLING GUNS IN THE GALLOPING GRIP OF A GLAMOROUS DRAMA! John Wayne stars as John Weston, a man hired to investigate shady doings at a local rodeo. It seems all the riders who are on the verge of winning end up dead. Along with Wayne, this tale of action on the range also stars the usual Lone Star Picture stock company, including Gabby Hayes and Yakima Canutt!

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: Killer on the Island
programme.desc: On vacation with her husband, a woman suspects a local of multiple murders and fears she's next.

programme.title: I Think I Do
programme.desc: The relationship between three sisters, as one is left at the altar on her wedding day.

programme.title: Kidnapped to the Island
programme.desc: When a teen aspiring to be a pop star disappears, her mom tracks her down, uncovering a sinister plot.

programme.title: Deadly Vows
programme.desc: Pastry chef Helena poisons men who don't meet her standards, but Helena's fiancé's sister smells danger.

programme.title: A Moving Romance
programme.desc: After inheriting her family's moving company, a young woman starts to clash with the manager who thought he was going to take over.

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: After 73 errors about firefighters in her last romance novel, Jo's publisher, Diana, insists on weeks of research for her next book by training at a military boot camp run by her navy seal brother.

programme.title: Love & Where to Find It
programme.desc: Two local coffee shop owners despise each other but begin to fall in love while sending each other messages on their friends' behalf.

programme.title: Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Young divorce lawyer Kelsey finds it safer to keep love out of her life - that is until a stray dog pairs her with Harrison, the local vet.

programme.title: Alter
programme.desc: Alter, a psychological thriller about a man who is convinced that he’s found his childhood abductor, and is determined to get him to confess by any means necessary.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: A lawyer is riding high after putting a receiving a Not Guilty verdict for her client, but has to look over her shoulder when a woman she meets in a traffic accident is not all she appears to be.

programme.title: Calling for Love
programme.desc: A podcast host who is cynical about love meets Jake, a charismatic and charming new caller.

programme.title: Amish Abduction
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: Dying for the Crown
programme.desc: A new student at a high school stops at nothing to gain popularity and become homecoming queen at the prom.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: A girl tries to play matchmaker for her widowed father when a woman rents one of his rooms.

programme.desc: Young divorce lawyer Kelsey finds it safer to keep love out of her life - that is until a stray dog pairs her with Harrison, the local vet.

programme.desc: A new student at a high school stops at nothing to gain popularity and become homecoming queen at the prom.

programme.title: Forever Love
programme.desc: A couple's lost love goes full circle between the 50's and the present.

programme.title: Eve of Abduction
programme.desc: When a single mother gets engaged, she receives a threat—break off the engagement or her daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: Eyewitness
programme.desc: It has been five years after Diana send a man to jail for the murder of her father and fiancee. Then he escapes from prison. He keeps her captive in her own home. Did Diana put an innocent man away?

programme.title: Forever in My Heart
programme.desc: Jenna and Charlie reunite in Ireland after five years, and Jenna must choose between love and her dreams.

programme.title: Love Map
programme.desc: A self-assured relationship columnist is sent on assignment with a prickly tour guide to Florida.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After many years, a group of friends reunite at the summer camp of their youth, which is on the verge of being sold off. When reliving their past joys, loves and sorrows, they open a time capsule that brings old tensions to the surface and inspires some newfound relationships.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Vicki is forced to repeat the same day over and over as she searches for an antiquity: Pandora’s Box.

programme.title: New Dogs, Old Tricks
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 New Dogs, Old Tricks
programme.desc: It's the day of the Gamma Fair, but Sarah doesn't want to go. Bundy rescues Kappa Psi Psi's bachelorette auction, but pays for it later.

programme.title: All of My heart 2
programme.desc: Brian and Jenny are preparing for the big opening of their bed and breakfast, Emily's Country Inn, when a huge storm hits Bucks County. Brian agrees to return to Wall Street to boost their funds, while Jenny scrambles to keep the opening on time.

programme.title: Forever Love
programme.desc: A couple's lost love goes full circle between the 50's and the present.

programme.title: Eve of Abduction
programme.desc: When a single mother gets engaged, she receives a threat—break off the engagement or her daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: Eyewitness
programme.desc: It has been five years after Diana send a man to jail for the murder of her father and fiancee. Then he escapes from prison. He keeps her captive in her own home. Did Diana put an innocent man away?

programme.title: Forever in My Heart

programme.title: Love Map
programme.desc: A self-assured relationship columnist is sent on assignment with a prickly tour guide to Florida.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After many years, a group of friends reunite at the summer camp of their youth, which is on the verge of being sold off. When reliving their past joys, loves and sorrows, they open a time capsule that brings old tensions to the surface and inspires some newfound relationships.

programme.title: Ex Next Door
programme.desc: A happy couple’s life turns upside down when the husband’s ex-girlfriend moves in next door.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: True crime writer, Kate, believes her children book writing days with her ex-boyfriend, Josh, are long over until her publisher requests a sequel. When problems begin to rise during the creative process, Kate and Josh decide to relive their past forcing them to fall in love all over again.

programme.title: Fbi: Negotiator
programme.desc: An FBI agent must negotiate with a woman holding a hospital hostage in order to get her hands on an experimental drug.

programme.title: Be Mine
programme.desc: A woman finds romance as she prepares to take over her mother's garden store.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: Sparks fly between an interior designer and a handsome pilot who finds homes for rescue dogs.

programme.title: The wrong Nanny
programme.desc: When Blake finds her birth mother and her now-perfect family, Blake will do anything it takes to destroy it.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Episode 17 - The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Henry’s old flame, Christina, is back and in need of his help. Vicki wonders if she has ulterior motives.

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: En uge før jul lander Estelle Svensson i Arlanda Lufthavn. Et år tidligere flygtede hun over stok og sten sammen med sin datter og manden Tommy, der netop havde begået et af de største røverier i svensk kriminalhistorie.

programme.title: Miraklet i Le Havre
programme.desc: I den finske film 'Miraklet i Le Havre' har den tidligere forfatter og nuværende boheme Marcel Marx slået sig ned i den nordfranske havneby Le Havre. Her lever han et stille liv mellem bistroen, arbejdet og kæresten Arletty. En dag lander den afrikanske dreng Idrissa på hans dørtrin.

programme.title: De uarvede
programme.desc: "De Værdiløse" er en tidløs beskrivelse af, hvordan den småkriminelle Manne, landsbydrengen Harri og den smukke Veera kører i en Volga gennem de forsvindende finske landskaber, mens politiet og gangstere konstant hænger på deres hæle.

programme.title: Løgneren
programme.desc: Løgneren er en beskrivelse af en ung svindler, der aldrig taler sandt. Den unge mand spillet af Aki Kaurismäki vandrer gennem Helsinkis gader og forsøger at låne penge fra bekendte og fremmede med forskellige påskud.

programme.title: Zombie og spøgelsestoget
programme.desc: Zombie er en selvstændig sjæl, der ikke kan følge de normer, det finske samfund har pålagt ham. Zombie beslutter sig for at forlade alt og drage udenlands - til et sted, hvor ingen forventer noget af ham. Zombie og spøgelsestoget betragtes af mange som nogle af Mika Kaurismäkis bedste film.

programme.title: Sønnen fra vingården
programme.desc: Den pengegriske konsul Martin ejer sammen med sin strikse kone (Kirsten Rolffes) Vingården, der I følge et testamente efter "onkel Olsen", ikke må forlade familien Martins eje før 30 år efter hans død.

programme.title: Brasileirinho
programme.desc: Mika Kaurismäkis dokumentar handler om den brasilianske musikstil choro, som kan betragtes som den første brasilianske musik.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Illona og Lauri arbejder begge hårdt for at få tingene til at løbe rundt, men forsøger at tage vare på hinanden – og deres hund – så godt de formår, når de endelig har fri.

programme.title: Gasolin'
programme.desc: Et intimt portræt af Danmarks mest indflydelsesrige rockband Gasolin'. For første gang siden de gik fra hinanden i 1978 reflekterer de fire bandmedlemmer over deres karriere og hvorfor de gik fra hinanden.

programme.title: Rosso
programme.desc: Rosso er historien om den sicilianske lejemorder Giancarlo Rosso, der er kommet til Finland for at finde sit næste mål, som tilfældigvis er hans elskede Marja. Uventet får Rosso hjælp til opsporingen fra Marjas bror Martti, selvom de ikke engang deler et fælles sprog.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha

programme.title: Projekt Z

programme.title: I Hired a Contract Killer

programme.title: Christmas Story
programme.desc: Da den unge Nikolas bliver forældreløs, bliver han adopteret af hvert hus i hans landsby i et år. Efter at han forlader huset, giver han dem en julegave og fortsætter traditionen, selv efter han er blevet voksen.

programme.title: Pas på dit tørklæde, Tatjana
programme.desc: To mænd tager på en rejse gennem Finland med to russiske kvinder og oplever en række komiske og rørende hændelser.

programme.title: The Last Border
programme.desc: På en gennemgribende forurenet planet er der kun få beboelige områder tilbage. Ved polarcirklen findes der et rent område, hvor beboerne kæmper for overlevelse mod en militærjunta og lovløse gerillabander. Men den farligste af mændene er den, der allerede har mistet alt.

programme.title: Moreno og stilheden
programme.desc: En pige bliver myrdet kort efter, at hun har forladt en lukket religiøs gruppe, og det bliver en vanskelig efterforskning for Moreno, da ingen i gruppen er villige til at samarbejde. Men da endnu en pige bliver kidnappet, og hendes blodige negle bliver sendt til politiet, begynder folk at tale.

programme.title: Lindell - Nattens Søster - Del 2
programme.desc: Brenda Elise Moen bliver skuddræbt uden for sit hjem i Ullevål Hageby, tilsyneladende uden noget motiv. Cato Isaksen og hans team bliver sat på sagen. Efterhånden opdager politiet, at også Brenda Elises barnebarn, den 14-årige Kathrine Bjerke, er forsvundet.

programme.title: Liza Marklund: Hedebølge
programme.desc: Midt på kirkegården ligger liget af en ung kvinde fra stripklubben Studio Sex. Ved første øjekast ligner det en simpel tragedie fra Stockholms prostitutionsmiljø. Men så kommer det frem, at en fremtrædende politiker har besøgt Studio Sex samme aften. Og snart er han mistænkt for mordet.

Her lever han et stille liv mellem bistroen, arbejdet og kæresten Arletty. En dag lander den afrikanske dreng Idrissa på hans dørtrin.

programme.title: Zombie og spøgelsestoget
programme.desc: Zombie er en selvstændig sjæl, der ikke kan følge de normer, det finske samfund har pålagt ham. Zombie beslutter sig for at forlade alt og drage udenlands - til et sted, hvor ingen forventer noget af ham. Zombie og spøgelsestoget betragtes af mange som nogle af Mika Kaurismäkis bedste film.

programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Den talentfulde advokat Casey McKay føres til en lille by af sin ekskone for at forsvare hendes bror, som er under anklage for at have myrdet en offentlig anklager. Her opdager McKay en sammensværgelse, som bringer ham i åben konflikt med byens mest korrupte bygherre, mr. Gates.

programme.title: American Exit
programme.desc: Charlie Bond står ved en skillevej i livet. Han er lige blevet separeret fra sin kone og bliver nu bedt om at passe deres søn Leo i en weekend. Det er dårlig timing, for han er netop i færd med at planlægge et kunstkup for at skaffe nogle hurtige penge.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: En psykedelisk thriller om tre unge voksne, som befinder sig i en ubegribelig tidslabyrint, hvor de vågner op til den samme skræmmende dag som den foregående.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: Jackie Chan spiller hovedrollen som Lin, en specialstyrkeagent i nutidens Hong Kong. Da hans team skal evakuere en specialist i biokemiske våben, havner de i et baghold lagt af en sindssyg, mekanisk forstærket skurk, og Lin er meget tæt på at dø.

programme.title: District 13 - Ultimatum
programme.desc: Tårnhøje mure omkranser Paris' ultra-kriminelle ghettoer, hvor fem forskellige bander hersker - nu med mere magt end nogensinde.

programme.title: Awake
programme.desc: En mand vågner på hospitalet uden erindring om, hvem han er, og finder ud af, at han er efterlyst for at have begået en række mord.

programme.title: The Fourth Musketeer
programme.desc: På sin fars vegne rejser den unge d'Artagnan fra landskabet i Gascogne til Paris, hvor han er involveret i et snedigt og meget kompliceret komplot mellem kongens musketerer og kardinal Richelieus vagter.

programme.title: Triassic Hunt
programme.desc: Da to genetisk fremstillede dinosaurer flygter fra laboratoriet, tilkaldes et hold lejesoldater for at fange dem. Men soldaterne indser snart, at dinosaurerne er lige så kloge som mennesker, og så er en vild kattens leg med musen i gang.

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Lissa og Rose er to 17-årige piger, der går i gymnasiet ligesom de fleste andre 17-årige piger. Forskellen er bare, at Lissa drikker blod og, og at deres gymnasium er en hemmelig kostskole for fredelige Moroi-vampyrer og deres beskyttere!

programme.title: Fingrene væk fra øen
programme.desc: Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er tilbage i den vildeste skattejagtskomedie. I håbet om at finde en begravet skat på en øde ø, prøver Hill at stikke af med Spencers båd, men efter et slagsmål ender de begge i vandet.

programme.title: Shockwave
programme.desc: Når en massiv vulkansk storm rammer verden, forsøger geofysikeren Kate Ferris at overbevise forsvarsministeriet om, at det ikke er et naturligt fænomen. Det er resultatet af en seismisk supermagt, kendt som Hell Storm, som er blevet aktiveret.

programme.title: Hjælp, jeg ser rødt
programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde.

programme.title: Ghost Rider - Spirit Of Vengeance
programme.desc: Johnny Blaze kæmper stadig med sin forbandelse som djævelens dusørjager. Og da han hyres til et job af en hemmelig religiøs sekt, føler han sig ikke parat til endnu en gang at påtage sig Ghost Riders flammende kræfter og magt. Men måske er dette den sidste mulighed for at gøre sig fri.

programme.title: Texas Red
programme.desc: Den sande historie om den legendariske Texas Red, en afroamerikansk mand, der blev jaget brutalt langs præriens barske landskab af hundredvis af lovløse cowboys gennem Mississippis vinterørken. Alt sammen for at gribe den mest eftertragtede belønning.

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: En tidligere guerillasoldat fra Boerkrigen får til opgave at finde en Maori der er anklaget for at have myrdet en britisk soldat. Under jagten opstår der en gensidig respekt for hinanden, men en flok ledet af en britisk officer, fast besluttet på at Maorien er skyldig, er lige i hælene på dem.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor og tidligere NASA-medarbejder gør den skrækindjagende opdagelse; at en destruktiv asteroide er på vej direkte mod Jorden. Nu må han beskytte sin familie; mens han gør verden opmærksom på den kommende ødelæggelse.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Den sande historie om Ben Aronoff, skaberen af verdens hurtigste speedbåde, venner med jetsettet, en mand med et blændende smil og penge som græs.

programme.title: End Of Watch
programme.desc: Los Angeles-betjentene Taylor og Zavala risikerer livet hver dag, når de patruljerer millionbyens værste kvarterer. De er lovens hårdeste håndhævere, og deres job er én konstant jagt efter gadens treenighed: Dope, money and guns!

programme.title: The Death & Life Of Bobby Z
programme.desc: En narkobetjent (Laurence Fishburne) skaffer den tidligere marineinfanterist Tim Kearney (Paul Walker) en vej ud af fængslet. Han skal udgive sig for Bobby Z, en nyligt afdød narkobagmand i en gidseludveksling med en gangsterkonge. Da udvekslingen går helt galt, flygter Kearney med Z’s søn på slæb.

programme.title: Army of One
programme.desc: Et pars romantiske ferie går grueligt galt, da de støder på et aggressivt kartel … Brenner, som har mistet alt, hævner sig nådesløst og eftertrykkeligt.

programme.title: Chariot
programme.desc: Syv fremmede mennesker vågner om bord på et passagerfly, der er i luften, uden at ane, hvordan de er havnet der, og hvor de er på vej hen.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Den sande historie om den irske kamppilot Brendan ”Paddy” Finucane, som i en alder af kun 21 år blev den yngste oberstløjtnant nogensinde i det engelske flyvevåben og en af de bedste og mest berømte flyveresser under anden verdenskrig.

programme.title: The Birdcage
programme.desc: Armand og Albert bygget det perfekte liv for sig selv ved at passe deres natklub i Miami. Men deres pastelfarvede ro bliver rystet, da Armands søn annoncerer, at han skal giftes med datteren til den ultrakonservative senator Keeley... og de skal alle spise middag sammen!

programme.title: Time Out of Mind
programme.desc: George er en desperat mand. Hans helbred vakler, og han har ingen steder at tage hen, da han bliver kastet ud i New York Citys nådesløse gader.

programme.title: Night Train to Lisbon
programme.desc: Den schweiziske professor Raimund Gregorius opgiver sine forelæsninger og sit afstressede liv for at begive sig ud på et spændende eventyr, der vil tage ham med på en rejse ind til selve hjertet.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: På en skæbnesvanger aften under Anden Verdenskrig opfører en gruppe turnerende skuespillere en forestilling af Shakespeares "King Lear" i et lille engelsk egnsteater.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Den alkoholiserede Matti, der bor under broerne, er ved at arve en betydelig sum penge fra sin amerikanske faster. Men manden skal se præsentabel ud under fasterens besøg. Matti fortæller sin ven, der arbejder som bilforhandler, om situationen, og han foreslår en rollebytte mod kompensation.

programme.title: Håbet er lysegrønt
programme.desc: Efter 30 års ægteskab deltager et midaldrende ægtepar i en intens, ugelang terapisession for at arbejde på deres forhold.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace er en almindelig pige som tilfældigvis bliver prinsesse, da en familierejse til Paris ender med at blive til hendes store fantasi. Ved at leve som kongelige, opdager Grace, sammen med sine to bedste venner, hvem hun virkelig er – ved at foregive en andens identitet.

programme.title: Copycat
programme.desc: En ambitiøs kriminalbetjent forsøger at lokke en kriminalpsykolog ud af sin isolerede tilværelse for at hjælpe med at fange en morder, som kopiere andre seriemorderes forbrydelser.

programme.title: Joy Ride
programme.desc: To brødre på køretur gennem landet begår den fejl at lave en prank på en mentalt forvirret lastbilchauffør og betaler dyrt for spøgen, da han forvandler sig til en morderisk stalker.

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: Fra producenterne bag ”IT” kommer CHILD’S Play, en helt ny version af den klassiske gyserhistorie om den onde dukke Chucky, nu med Mark Hamill som stemmen bag.

programme.title: Palo Alto
programme.desc: High School-eleverne Teddy, April, Fred og Emily er ligesom alle andre på jagt efter noget at lave i Palo Altos kedelige forstadsmiljø.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Håbet er lysegrønt
programme.desc: Efter 30 års ægteskab deltager et midaldrende ægtepar i en intens, ugelang terapisession for at arbejde på deres forhold.

programme.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
programme.desc: En enke fra kystvagten og en enke, der designer tasker, forelsker sig og gifter sig, til stor fortrydelse for hendes 10 og hans 8 børn. Mens børnene planlægger at skille deres forældre ad, indser de, at det vigtigste er familien.

programme.title: Hollywood's hemmelighed
programme.desc: I 1924 samlede mediemogul William Randolph Hearst nogle af verdens mest kendte personligheder til en sejltur på hans yacht, hvilket resulterede i et stadig uløst, neddysset mord.

programme.title: Saints Of War
programme.desc: Jersey, 1942. Da Hitler strammer grebet om Vesteuropa, bliver Kanaløerne besat. Tyskerne brugere Jersey som en base, hvor krigsfanger knokler i arbejdslejre, og indbyggerne står over for en fremtid fuld af usikkerhed og frygt.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: KC er fortvivlet, da lokale bøller stjæler hans hund og kræver at få de 10.000 dollars han skylder dem. Hans forhenværende bedste ven, Jack, fortæller at han har pengene...

programme.title: De uarvede
programme.desc: "De Værdiløse" er en tidløs beskrivelse af, hvordan den småkriminelle Manne, landsbydrengen Harri og den smukke Veera kører i en Volga gennem de forsvindende finske landskaber, mens politiet og gangstere konstant hænger på deres hæle.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Den sande historie om den irske kamppilot Brendan ”Paddy” Finucane, som i en alder af kun 21 år blev den yngste oberstløjtnant nogensinde i det engelske flyvevåben og en af de bedste og mest berømte flyveresser under anden verdenskrig.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk pigeskole i hjertet af Chicago, byen som er hjem for USA's mest populære danseshow: Dance TV! Udvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrag, da hun bliver præsenteret for sine fnisende klassekammerater af den strenge søster Katherine.

programme.title: Welcome to Collinwood
programme.desc: Cosimo får en plan for et kæmpe job af sin cellekammerat. Han beder sin kvinde om at finde en patsy for sit forkludrede biltyveri og tilbyder 15.000 dollars. Pludselig er 7 involveret.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: Den indre historie om planlægningen, udførelsen, de oprørende eftervirkninger og det endelige fald for kidnapperne af ølmagnaten Alfred "Freddy" Heineken i 1983, hvilket resulterede i den største løsesum nogensinde betalt for et individ.

programme.title: 9 1/2 uge (9½ Weeks)
programme.desc: En kvinde indleder et forhold til en mand, hun dårligt kender. Deres seksuelle eskapader fører til flere og flere forviklinger. Erotisk kultfilm med Oscar-vinderen Kim Basinger og Oscar-nominerede Mickey Rourke

programme.title: Elegy
programme.desc: Den aldrende litteraturprofessor David lever alene og har en forkærlighed for unge studerende. En dag møder han den smukke Consuela og forfører hende uden seriøse hensigter. Efterhånden uddybes deres forhold, og den gamle kyniker opdager pludselig, at han er forelsket.

programme.title: Pigen fra tændstikfabrikken
programme.desc: En kvinde, der arbejder på en tændstikfabrik, oplever en række uheldige hændelser, der fører til, at hun træffer en drastisk beslutning.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Management
programme.desc: Man kan komme langt på et glas champagne og et klap bagi! En frustreret forretnings-kvinde på salgstur? Og en kikset motelbestyrer med smag for billig champagne og runde bagdele? Ikke nogen vinder-kombination, men meget kan ske på et ensomt motorvejshotel...

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: To udødelige, forbundne sjæle transcenderer tid og rum, som den ene desperat søger at redde den anden for at indfri et løfte om evigt liv.

programme.desc: Dette hårde drama følger to gymnasiekammerater, Hancock og Danny, efter at de er færdige. Hancock og hans cheerleader-kæreste går videre til en middelklasse-middelmådighed, der ligger uden for rækkevidde for Danny og hans psykotiske kone Bev.

programme.title: The Birdcage
programme.desc: Armand og Albert bygget det perfekte liv for sig selv ved at passe deres natklub i Miami. Men deres pastelfarvede ro bliver rystet, da Armands søn annoncerer, at han skal giftes med datteren til den ultrakonservative senator Keeley... og de skal alle spise middag sammen!

programme.title: Min Lejlighed I Paris
programme.desc: Mathias rejser fra New York til Paris for at afvikle en kæmpestor lejlighed, som han netop har arvet fra den far, han aldrig rigtig har kendt. Da han ankommer, opdager han til sin meget store overraskelse, at den 90-årige Mathilde bor i lejligheden med sin datter Chloe.

programme.title: Flight World War II
programme.desc: Fanget i en kamp mellem Tyske og allierede styrker, kæmper passagererne i en moderne 757 jet for at overleve efter, at de er taget tilbage i tiden til 1940. I deres forsøg på at overleve, lykkes det at påvirke historien, og slutningen på Anden Verdenskrig.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming To Christmas Dinner?
programme.desc: Den aktivistiske, liberale og progressive jurastuderende Maya tager sin nye kæreste med hjem til jul uden at fortælle familien, at han er hvid. Gæt hvem der kommer til julemiddag?

programme.title: De uarvede

programme.title: Seeking a Friend for the End of the World
programme.desc: Hvis du fik at vide du havde 21 dagetilbage at leve i, hvad ville du så gøre? Om tre uger vil jorden blive tilintetgjort af en gigantisk meteor, og i panik over dette forlades Dodge (Steve Carell) af sin kone.

programme.title: Savage Salvation
programme.desc: De nyforlovede Shelby John (Jack Huston) og Ruby Red (Willa Fitzgerald) har med Peters (John Malkovich) hjælp lagt deres liv om. Da Shelby finder Ruby død på deres veranda, tager han på et blodtørstigt hævntogt efter de skyldige narkohajer.
